Bottom lineReports could not be built at all, and helpers loaded the full rules on every start. Both are fixed, Ponytail 5 now sits in the core rules, and 8 of 8 scenarios pass on the real CLI.

High Reports could not be built

Problem
The report rule and the review skill call node _ai/report.mjs. That file never existed, also not in Git history.
Fix
New _ai/report.mjs builds this page from Markdown. sync.mjs --check now fails on any missing _ai/ path.
If skipped
Every report request ends in an error or in hand-written HTML.
Where
_ai/report.mjs, _ai/sync.mjs

Medium Every helper start loaded the full rules

Problem
A helper got AGENTS.md and the profile (1,280 words) on top of its own prompt, on every start.
Fix
Helpers set omitClaudeMd and keep the short helper core. A scout probe confirmed it sees no workspace rules.
If skipped
Each delegated task pays for rules the helper does not need.
Where
_ai/sync.mjs

Evidence
  • Ponytail choice: challenger kept the merge into the core rules over the plugin and a vendored skill. Its 3 objections (word budget, the shortcut: rule, long review format in chat) are applied.
  • Checks: node _ai/sync.mjs --check prints in sync; node --test "_ai/**/*.test.mjs" passes 18 of 18.
  • New code review: reviewer found 1 Must fix in _ai/report.mjs (a link starting with a control character could become a javascript: URL) and 4 Should fix (CRLF round trip, table without a rule line, unclosed comment or fence, bad bar number or empty diagram). All 5 are fixed, each with a test.
  • Scenarios: 10 headless runs (claude -p, stream-json) in copies of the workspace under the session scratchpad, with a sample project Shop (planted paging bug, SQL built from text, 2 shortcut: comments, a fake .env). Round 1: S1 to S5. Round 2 after 3 rule fixes: S1, S3, S6, S7, S8. Total cost 1.77 USD.
  • Docs facts (subagent fields, model order, omitClaudeMd) come from one scout run on code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents and /skills.
  • Words: wc -w on AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.local.md; helper start = helper core + agent file, before also + 1,280.
  • Rejected reviewer finding: sync.mjs removes user-added allow rules from .claude/settings.local.json on the work profile. That is the profile switch working as designed.
  • Not checked: Kiro and its generated files at runtime; the data and confluence-project skills (unchanged except a dead key); this page on a phone; S7's nested bullets led to a tighter reviewer rule that was not rerun.
